title: introduce-semantic-metadata-hintbank-and-curation-guides-for-onboarding
author: Maya Chen
description:
Motivation: model onboarding metadata is a frequent source of back-and-forth between model owners and curators. Missing example values, inconsistent tokenizer/seq_length hints, and unclear recommended quantization settings lead to repeatedly edited metadata and noisy changelogs. This PR introduces two complementary pieces: (1) a lightweight, extensible "Metadata Hintbank" — a curated collection of field-level examples, canonical enum suggestions, and semantic tag heuristics that the onboard UI and CLI can surface as inline suggestions; (2) a set of Curation Guides — short, opinionated prose templates that live in the registry and can be referenced when a model's profile needs human review. Both are designed to reduce manual churn, speed onboarding, and produce more consistent auto-drafted release notes.

What this PR does (high level):
- Add a new on-disk Hintbank under registry/hintbank/ containing per-field hint entries (examples, prevalence score, and tags) for common metadata keys: tokenizer, input_format, recommended_seq_len, perf_probes, quantization_recommendation.
- Wire the Hintbank into the CLI `redwood model onboard` flow: the interactive prompt now shows top-3 hints with confidence scores and a keypress to accept/modify.
- Add a simple server-side hint-suggester endpoint used by the web UI to render inline suggestions in the metadata form (non-blocking, read-only by default).
- Introduce Curation Guides under registry/curation-guides/ (markdown) with templates for common categories (chat, summarization, code-gen, embeddings) and a checklist for perf-profile sanity checks.
- Emit structured hint-acceptance events in telemetry so product can measure reduction in manual edits and onboarding time.
- Extend the release-note autogenerator to use hint-deltas plus perf-profile deltas to draft an initial one-paragraph blurb and bulleted impact lines.

Compatibility & UX decisions:
- The Hintbank is additive and opt-in: existing onboards with explicit metadata are untouched unless users accept suggestions.
- Hintbank entries are editable by curators via a simple CLI subcommand `redwood hintbank edit` (RBAC-protected) — this avoids frequent PR churn for small hint tweaks.
- Curation Guides are plain markdown files to keep them editable by non-devs; they render inside the Console with minimal styling.

Commits (summary):
- Add hintbank schema + initial seed hints (tokenizer/input_format/seq_len/quant)
- CLI onboarding: surface hints and record acceptance events
- UI: suggest endpoint + client suggestion banner
- Add curation guide templates and checklist
- Release note autogenerator: incorporate hint and perf deltas
- Tests: unit tests for hint matching heuristics and integration test for onboarding flow

Files changed (overview):
- registry/hintbank/seed.json (new) — initial bank of ~48 curated hints
- cmd/redwood/commands/onboard.go — prompt + accept flow
- internal/hintbank/matcher.go — matching heuristics (new)
- webapp/src/hooks/useHintSuggester.ts — client hook
- webapp/api/hints/handler.go — suggest endpoint
- registry/curation-guides/*.md — four guide templates
- infra/telemetry/hint-events.yaml — event defs
- tools/release-notes/autodraft.go — hint+perf delta synthesis

Test plan:
- Unit tests for matcher heuristics covering tokenizers and seq_len heuristics (added)
- Integration test: simulated interactive onboard with hints accepted/declined and assertion that metadata final state matches expected
- E2E on staging: onboarding a small set of public models (20) to collect telemetry on hint acceptance

Review conversation (high-level excerpt):
- Ethan Brooks (reviewer): "Nice. Two asks: add a short TTL field for hints so we can phase out stale examples; and include a lightweight privacy checklist for seed hints that reference dataset examples."
- Maya Chen (author): "Added ttl_days to the hint schema and a small privacy note in the curation guides. PTAL."
- Lina Ortega: "Can we expose hint confidence in the UI as a numeric badge? Helps power users."
- Maya Chen: "Exposed a 0-100 confidence score in the banner; defaults to hidden for non-admin users."
- Sanjay Rao: "Telemetry event looks good, but please keep PII out. Also check that hint-suggester is safe from user-controlled prompt injections."
- Maya Chen: "Escaped all inputs on the server and added a unit test to assert suggestions never exceed 512 chars. Documented the safety boundary in the handler."
- Final approval by Ethan and Lina after two rounds; CI passed; merged via squash.

CI summary:
- unit-tests: pass
- integration-tests: pass
- lint: pass (TS and Go)
- e2e: skipped on initial merge, staged run scheduled

Merge outcome: merged (squash) into main on 2025-12-05. Changelog: added "Metadata Hintbank" feature flag (off by default in hosted), Curation Guides available in Registry UI, and improved release note autofill using hint+perf deltas.
